senses.sense_definition: Assistance and support in times of hardship and distress; relief.

examples.text: The international community worked tirelessly to bring <w>succor</w> to the displaced refugees.￺The international community worked tirelessly to bring <w>succor</w> to the displaced refugees.￻

senses.sense_definition: To give assistance, aid, or relief to someone in a time of distress or difficulty.

examples.text: The volunteers arrived swiftly to <w>succor</w> the victims of the devastating flood.￺The volunteers arrived swiftly to <w>succor</w> the victims of the devastating flood.￻
